fusions.name: Concealed Edge
fusions.desc: A cut with the trowel's edge at a target at or below 30% of its health that deals 20 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slate Slivers
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 slivers of slate in a spread; each deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Behind the Scaffold
fusions.desc: You fade from sight for 6 seconds: enemies pay you 60% less attention, and you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Second Edge
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
